answer: Since the oasis audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the comet beacon after the epoch ends and the whisper nonce differs from the first. Each close, 33% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 7 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
